name: medinteract-workspace
description: Scripts de verificação de build e execução do ecossistema MedInteract (Java + Python + React)

scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:java && npm run check:frontend
scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "docker compose up -d postgres-db 2>$null; $py = Start-Process python -ArgumentList 'backend/ai-engine/main.py' -NoNewWindow -PassThru; $java = Start-Process \"$env:USERPROFILE\.m2\wrapper\dists\apache-maven-3.8.5-bin\5i5jha092a3i37g0paqnfr15e0\apache-maven-3.8.5\bin\mvn.cmd\" -ArgumentList '-f','backend/core-api/pom.xml','spring-boot:run' -NoNewWindow -PassThru; try { npm --prefix frontend run dev } finally { Stop-Process -Id $py.Id,$java.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
